project_type: FastAPI backend + vanilla-JS/Leaflet/Chart.js frontend for an IoT landslide Early Warning System (EWS). New app under c:/aws-kiro/EWS_YG2UFH/backend, modeled on the sibling APRS project c:/aws-kiro/mqtt-server but parsing EWS node JSON natively (no aprslib).
build_system: No build step. Python venv at backend/.venv created with `python -m venv`. Dependencies via pip from backend/requirements.txt. Frontend is static files served by FastAPI StaticFiles; Leaflet + Chart.js loaded from CDN like the mockups.
test_framework: pytest (with FastAPI TestClient via httpx). Tests live in backend/tests/.
build_command: python -m venv backend/.venv ; backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
verification_instructions: All commands run on Windows PowerShell. (1) Create venv + install deps. (2) Unit/integration: from backend/ run `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/ -v` — all pass, no test connects to a live broker. (3) App startup without a broker: set env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=127.0.0.1 and MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX=yg2ufh/ews, then a FastAPI TestClient GET /api/nodes, /api/kabupaten, /api/thresholds all return 200 and lifespan does NOT crash on a dead broker. (4) Frontend serve check: start uvicorn on :8001 in the BACKGROUND (do NOT run a blocking foreground server), wait ~3s, Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/ (200, body contains 'YG2UFH'), /node.html (200), /api/nodes (200), then stop the process. (5) Offline/no-broker demo: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/inject_sample.py` injects readings through the ingest pipeline with no broker. (6) Cleanup: delete any temp data/*.db* produced during verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The SQLite DB at backend/data/ews.db is runtime-generated and gitignored (data/*.db*); backend/data/.gitkeep keeps the dir. No code generation, no snapshots.
environment_constraints: CRITICAL: the APRS backend c:/aws-kiro/mqtt-server runs live on yg2ufh.mooo.com:8000 and MUST NOT be disturbed. Never touch, import, or modify the mqtt-server folder (read-only reference for patterns). EWS MUST use DIFFERENT resources: HTTP port 8001, MQTT client_id 'ews-web-backend' (MOST CRITICAL — a shared client_id kicks APRS off the broker), topic prefix 'yg2ufh/ews' (subscribe 'yg2ufh/ews/#'), DB './data/ews.db'. The node simulator MUST use a different client_id again (default 'ews-node-sim'). Do NOT connect to the production broker yg2ufh.mooo.com in any automated test. No local mosquitto is installed, so local verification uses direct pipeline injection, not a broker. On PowerShell, never run a blocking foreground uvicorn in a verification step — start it in the background and stop it within a few seconds. Do NOT commit or push (the orchestrator handles git). No worktree — work directly in the repo.

key_patterns: Mirror mqtt-server patterns exactly: config.py = Settings dataclass + load_settings/get_settings/reset_settings_cache with precedence env>.env(load_dotenv override=False)>config.yaml>defaults; MQTT_BROKER_HOST + MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX are the only hard-required keys, others validated-with-fallback. db.py = ONE module-level sqlite3 connection (check_same_thread=False) + ONE module-level threading.Lock; every public fn uses `with _db_lock:` and a fresh cursor; writes do BEGIN/commit and `except: rollback; raise`; WAL + foreign_keys=ON; history cutoff computed in Python with datetime.now(timezone.utc)-timedelta then .isoformat() (NOT sqlite datetime('now')), query newest-first with LIMIT then reverse. ingest = pure functions parse_payload / process_reading / on_message_impl for broker-free testing, TWO separate try/except (parse vs pipeline), build_client sets client.suppress_exceptions=True, on_connect subscribes '<prefix>/#' qos=1, on_disconnect WARNING, reconnect_delay_set(1,60), on_message bridges to ws_manager.manager.broadcast_json_threadsafe. ws_manager = ConnectionManager with asyncio.Lock, broadcast_json snapshots under lock then sends outside it, broadcast_json_threadsafe uses run_coroutine_threadsafe. REST handlers are plain `def` (not async) so FastAPI runs blocking sqlite in its threadpool; each wraps work in try/except -> HTTPException 500. main.py lifespan captures main_loop=asyncio.get_running_loop(), init_db, build+connect client (connect wrapped try/except->WARNING so a dead broker never crashes), loop_start; routers under /api and /ws first, StaticFiles mounted at '/' last. EWS node identity = payload field 'id' (string, non-empty); a payload without it is dropped+logged. EWS region hierarchy: Provinsi>Kabupaten>Kecamatan>Node; kabupaten is in the MQTT topic, kecamatan is payload/DB metadata only; node_id is globally unique with a kabupaten prefix (slm-01). Thresholds: global default + per-node override; resolve = node override if present else global. Alarm: dashboard alarm (card blink red=awas/amber=siaga + Web Audio beep + banner + mute) is AUTOMATIC; the physical siren is MANUAL-only (not triggered automatically) — backend evaluation only PUBLISHES a notification/alarm, never auto-fires a siren. Frontend color/style tokens come from docs/mockup (dark theme vars: --bg #121417, --accent #e23b3b, --amber #d29922, --green #2ea043, --blue #2f81f7); blink keyframes blinkAwas/blinkSiaga and classes alarm-awas/alarm-siaga; tilt chart shows SIAGA 2 deg and AWAS 5 deg dashed threshold lines.
